{"code": "from collections import Counter

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq for each patient
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates
df_dedup = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Verify deduplication
print("Number of unique patient_id after deduplication:", df_dedup['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Number of rows after deduplication:", len(df_dedup))

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("Count of -999 in biomarker_baseline after deduplication:", (df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Apply correction to assay_batch B: divide biomarker_final by 10
df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
mask_batch_b = df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B'
df_dedup.loc[mask_batch_b, 'biomarker_final_corrected'] = df_dedup.loc[mask_batch_b, 'biomarker_final'] / 10

# Verify the correction worked
print("Mean biomarker_final_corrected in batch A:", df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'A', 'biomarker_final_corrected'].mean())
print("Mean biomarker_final_corrected in batch B:", df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'].mean())

# Check the distribution of severity by arm in the deduplicated data
print("\nDistribution of severity by arm (after deduplication):")
print(df_dedup.groupby(['arm', 'severity']).size().unstack(fill_value=0))"}
